name: python-answers-the-real-account-question-once
breaks: a second Python answer to the real-account question appears beside the one in caption_blocks, named for the same thing and deciding differently. That is the state this repository was actually in: generate_captions._is_real_handle checked the sentinel half only, so 'DPR Dance' passed it, and a shared name is read as evidence of shared behaviour, so nobody compared them (L263, #926)
